text: Spray WD-40 on your feet and watch what happens.
you just found out what has been living on them.
In a container, spray three to four times in container,
add two cups of warm water
and one spoonful of baking soda.
Soak for 15 minutes and watch the foam.
That fizz is a chemical reaction
with the bacteria and dead skin
that your soap has been missing for years.
It clears the odor, softens cracked heels,
and even thick yellow nails begin growing out clear again.
In wellness practices in the USA,
we say that the body speaks through the feet.
The soles carry what the rest of the body leaves behind.
This simple remedy is one way to begin listening.
